chunks: ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥasan ibn Faḍḍāl, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī and Muḥammad ibn al-Zayyāt, from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Ghiyāth ibn Ibrāhīm, from Abī ʿAbdillāh, from his father, from ʿAlī عليه السلام.
“He disliked that a man should ride along with the جنازة at the beginning, except due to an excuse.” And he said: “He may ride when he returns.”

key_terms.الْجَنَازَةِ: the funeral or bier being accompanied
key_terms.بَدَايَةٍ: the beginning or initial stage of the procession
key_terms.كَرِهَ: he regarded as disliked or reprehensible

ai.seo_question: Is it disliked to ride while accompanying a funeral procession at the beginning?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys a ruling of etiquette concerning accompanying a funeral procession. It indicates dislike for riding at the outset of the funeral procession without an excuse, while permitting riding on the return journey.
